Name: Eleasah, Son of Rapha
Summary: Son of Rapha and father of Azel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:37; 1 Chronicles 9:43: Son of Rapha and father of Azel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Eleasah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
